about: Held-out set v2 for #640's direct record-built response (written Nov 8 after held-out run 1, which is now development data). Frozen before its single run; do not tune against it before reporting. Synthetic; topics are new (none from v1, the 43 development answers or earlier fixtures). Expected labels are Claude's. It deliberately includes cases the Nov 8 fixes do not cover (an -ation word whose verb is not '-ate', list requests, pronoun-only requests, new answer-quality wording) so it is not written around those fixes.
